article.title: The USS Lincoln’s ‘leisure trip’ to Thailand: a port call of U.S. neocolonialism and femicide
article.author: Editor
article.content: The system where women are systematically wrapped into sex work due to existing infrastructure and poverty, where U.S. military presence creates the demand, and where Western tourism perpetuates supply–this is femicide.
